::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 25th 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 57
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

They have only sent me the first 19 columns of the [French primer](cmy_books/cmybook_353.qmd), which I had [illegible] and which only want a little correction of the [illegible]. What I want is the latter half which I know was once set up, but which has not been lengthened, as this earlier part has been

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
